required_invariants: No benchmark-critical Claim may exist without ClaimEvidence.
Every ClaimEvidence row must link to Evidence with Source provenance.
Snapshot-derived Evidence must include SourceContentSnapshot and SourceContentSegment provenance.
A derived or mirrored source must not create independent corroboration.
Contested Claims must remain visible in structured synthesis.
Required evidence gaps must prevent COMPLETE completion assessment.
Human review pending must remain explicit.
Structured synthesis must not invent Claims or Conclusions.
